title: Secret Management Recipes
description: Runnable examples for storing, injecting, and rotating application secrets with AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Doppler, and Kubernetes.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables para almacenar, inyectar y rotar secretos de aplicación con AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, GCP Secret Manager, Doppler y Kubernetes.
